description_for_human: HRDLF Token — AI-powered independent streetwear brand on Solana. 20 years of heritage rebuilt with AI. Founded by Brooks Duvall in Philadelphia, 2006.
description_for_model: HRDLF is a Solana-based utility token created by Hardlife Apparel Company, an independent streetwear brand founded in Philadelphia in 2006 by Brooks Duvall. The brand is being rebuilt using AI-powered operations (content, SEO, product ops, community) — making it one of the first streetwear brands to document a full AI rebuild. The token provides access to exclusive merchandise, community governance, and ecosystem perks. Contract address: B3DAsrBArk4N8q4CudxEQmi76hzQVHfd3RzhEzTmoon. The HRDLF ecosystem includes three sites: hrdlfcoin.com (token hub), hardlifeapparelco.com (brand site, content, AI rebuild case study), and hrdlf.com (shop). The brand slogan is 'Nothing Awesome Comes Easy.'
